title: THE QUEEN OF WOLVES // HOMEWARD BOUND
narrative: The galley docks in the salt mist of Maidenpool. Arya steps onto Westerosi soil, her boots crunching on frozen reeds. In her dreams, she runs on four legs beneath the moon. A chorus of savage howls answers from the Whispering Wood—Nymeria's giant wolfpack, hundreds strong, converges on the tree line to flank their long-lost alpha.

options.text: Lead the wolfpack south into the Riverlands to find Lady Stoneheart.
Ride north toward the Neck to hunt the Freys and Boltons.
